chapter.verse: Tua ciangin biakinnpi pan awging lianpi khat, vanmi sagihte a hopih ka za a, “Pai unla Pasian' lungsona kuang-uk sagihte leitung ah va sungkhia un,” ci hi.
Vanmi khatna zong va pai-in leitung ah a kuang-uk sungkhia a, sapi ciaptehna lim a nei, ama' milim a bia mite' tungah a lauhuai leh a siahuai meimate piang hi.
Vanmi nihna in tuipi tungah a kuang-uk sungkhia a, tuipi pen misite' sisan tawh hong kibangin tuipi sunga om nuntakna a nei khempeuh si hi.
Vanmi thumna in gunte leh tuinakte tungah a kuang-uk sungkhia a, tuate sisan suak hi.
Tua ciangin tui a uk vanmi hong pau a, hih bangin ka za hi: “Tu laitaka om, a om ngeisa ahi, Siangthopa aw, nang na thutang hi, hih thute nangma' khen ahi hi.
Amaute in mi siangthote leh kamsangte' sisan luangsak uh ahih manin amaute' dawn dingin sisan na pia hi. Hih pen amau tawh a kituak ahi hi.”
Tua ciangin biakpiaktau hong pau a, hih bangin ka za hi: “Himah hi, Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, nangma' thukhennate thumaanin thutang hi.”
Vanmi lina in ni tungah a kuang-uk sungkhia a, mei tawh mite a hul gawp dingin ni in phalna ngah hi.
Nakpi-a khauh meisa in mite hul gawp a, amaute in hih gimpinate' tunga uktheihna a nei Pasian' min samsia uh hi. Amaute kisik lo uh a, Pasian zong minpha pia lo uh hi.
Vanmi ngana in sapi ii kumpi-tokhom tungah a kuang-uk sungkhia a, sapi ii kumpigam khimzing vat hi. Mite in zong na sakna tawh a leii uh pet uh hi.
A natna uh leh a meima uh' hangin vantung Pasian samsia uh a, amau' sepkhiatte uh pan kisik lo uh hi.
Vanmi gukna in Euphrates gun lianpi tungah a kuang-uk sungkhia a, tua gun zong nisuahlam pana kumpite' ading lampi a bawlkholhna-in a tuite kangcip hi.
Tua ciangin gulpi samnei ii kam sungpan, sapi ii kam sungpan leh kamsang zuaupa ii kam sungpan uiphuk tawh a kibang kha nin thum hong pusuak ka mu hi.
Amau pen kihilna limte a bawl, dawi tawh kisai khate hi a, Vanglian Pasian ii ni thupini galkidona ah a kihel dingin leitung bup-a kumpite' kiangah va pai-in tua kumpite a kaikhawm uh ahi hi.
(En un, guta bangin kei kong pai ding hi. Guaktangin a pai, milak ah a maizumhuai a suah loh nadingin pilvang navakin a puantual tungsilh a silh mi, thuphangah ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin tua khate Hebrew-kamin Armageddon a kicihna mun ah kikaikhawm uh hi.
Vanmi sagihna in huihlak ah a kuang-uk a sunkhiat ciangin biakinn sung kumpi-tokhom pan awging lianpi khat hong suak a, “Man ta!” ci hi.
Tua ciangin khuaphia, vanging, kekkia, leh leitung ah mihing a om huna kipan a piang ngei nailo zinling lianpi khat piang a, tua zinling nakpi-in hupha hi.
Khuapi lian zong khen thum kisuah a, leitung minamte' khuapite puk uh hi. Pasian in Babylon khua lianpi mangngilh lo-in ama' lungsona lengtui hai dawnkangsak hi.
Tuikulh khempeuh maimang a, mual khempeuh kimukha nawnlo hi

Gialtang golpipi, khat ciangin tawi sawmthum kiim c a gikte, van panin mite' tungah kiasuk a, tua gimpina suksia lua ahih manin mite in gialtang gimpina hangin Pasian samsia uh hi. Numei Kizuak Miliannu leh Sapi
